content:
YouTube has acknowledged an issue affecting both Android and iPhone platforms, where Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode fails to activate when users exit the app.

Some users have "experienced the issue where the Picture-in-Picture (PiP) feature does not trigger after leaving the YouTube app." Users are supposed to see a floating player in the corner to continue watching, but YouTube displays nothing and only continues playing audio in the background.

According to Google, "the vast majority of related reports come from iOS users," though there are also some cases on Android devices. We were able to reproduce this issue on an iPhone running YouTube app version 21.28, but not on a Pixel device.

YouTube first identified the issue on Friday morning (Pacific Time) and stated that "the team is actively investigating the matter." However, as of Saturday afternoon, there has been no progress. Users can follow YouTube's support thread for the latest updates.

YouTube began rolling out the Picture-in-Picture feature to free users globally earlier this year.
